sources.name: Index polygons spatial data (INSPIRE)
sources.role: Operational dataset description and title-registration lookup role

sources.name: National Polygon Service dataset
sources.role: Current service description covering freehold and leasehold title polygons
sources.limitations: Indicative title boundaries are not surveyed legal boundaries

sources.name: OS Open UPRN
sources.role: Authoritative UPRN coordinates for addressable locations
sources.limitations: UPRN identifies an addressable location, not necessarily one legal title or one building footprint

sources.role: Authoritative cross-reference among UPRN, USRN and TOID identifiers
